notes:
{虎|とら} means tiger, a large striped wild cat.

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {虎|とら}: common writing
- {寅|とら}: used for zodiac

ZODIAC:
{寅|とら} is the third animal of the Chinese zodiac (⟦{十二支|じゅうにし}→十二支：27602_juunishi⟧). ⟦{寅年|とらどし}→寅年：noentry⟧ is the Year of the Tiger.
